items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: that's where Lee Collins, that's the first time I ever heard Lee Collins in my life he played right in there.

ctx.x: This Ritz or the Puppe, where was that exact?

On Iberville between Burgundy and Ramport. Right where the fern dance hall was. Right where the fern was. That's the same building. There was two, there was two right together, one right next to each other, you see. The Puppe was the first one, the Puppe was where the fern was. And next to that was the Haymarket, which later become the Lavia. That's where Collins played, you know. Lee Collins, that's where he played. Tony Perranti, I believe. Well no, that's another Lavia. The Lavia that Tony Perranti played, it…
So what went on in the district after you were in the city, it was supposed to be closed about the time of the First World War.
